title: Observed handwashing flow

actions.label: Dispense soap
actions.reason: A hand is held under the wall dispenser; white soap is visible on the palm in the next sample.
actions.uncertainty: The dispenser actuation is partly hidden by the hand.

actions.label: Rub hands with lather
actions.reason: Foamy hands rub together over the sink, including palms, backs and fingers.
actions.uncertainty: These are sampled views of several rubbing motions, grouped as one activity.

actions.label: Rinse under running water
actions.reason: Hands are held and rubbed under the visible faucet stream; lather diminishes.
actions.uncertainty: The 11.25-second crossfade does not establish the exact transition time.

actions.label: Pull a paper towel
actions.reason: A hand pulls a white sheet from the wall dispenser and then holds the separated towel.

actions.label: Dry hands with the towel
actions.reason: Both hands rub and fold the white towel between them beside the dispenser.

actions.label: Hold door handle with towel
actions.reason: A hand grips a chrome door lever through a white towel beside a lined waste bin.
actions.uncertainty: Actual door opening is not established by the sampled frames.

actions.label: Lower towel into the bin
actions.reason: The hand lowers the used white towel into the opening of the lined waste bin.
actions.uncertainty: The hand and rim obscure the exact moment the towel is released.
